top.title: Treasury, Eurozone Bond Yields Fall as Risk Aversion Beats Inflation Fears
top.summary: U.S. Treasury and German Bund yields slid to multiweek lows as investors’ focus seemed to shift away from inflation to concerns over the impact of high-borrowing costs on the economic outlook.

top.title: Stocks Gain as Treasury Yields Give Back Some Recent Gains
top.summary: U.S. stocks rose despite tech sector volatility and a hot wholesale inflation reading.

top.title: Oil Prices End Mixed as Traders Weigh Demand Outlook, Hormuz Shipping Risks
top.summary: Oil futures settled mixed as traders weighed a weaker global demand outlook and signs of recovering Middle East crude supplies against persistent shipping risks around the Strait of Hormuz.

top.title: Gold Futures Settle Higher As U.S. Yields, Dollar Fall
top.summary: Gold futures snapped a three-session losing streak with support from a drop in U.S. yields and a weaker dollar.

top.title: Dow Industrials, Treasurys Rise as Investors Rotate Out of Tech
